content: हयः [हय्-हि-वा अच्] .²1 A horse; ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ <ls>Bg. 1. 14</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 296</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 10</ls>. .²2 A man of a particular class; see under अश्व. .²3 The number ‘seven’. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Indra. .²5 (In prosody) A foot of four short syllables. .²6 The zodiacal sign Sagittarius. .²7 The Yak (Bos Grunniens).
